title: The Variance Risk Premium Over Trading and Nontrading Periods
summary: Variance premium is not an owned ES directional strategy.
about: Variance risk compensation across trading and nontrading intervals.
findings: Source concerns implied and realized variance payoffs, not a daily VIX-only ES timing rule.
mechanism: Compensation for bearing variance/tail risk is proposed; it is not free futures directional alpha.
